description: sdlc: security-guidance (pattern warnings; turn-end and commit model review only while a security-touched feature is active, ADR 0019), hookify (rules from .claude/hookify.*.local.md and committed .claude/hookify/*.md; evaluated before tool use, on prompts and on stop); verify-freshness (Review, Stage 5, only: blocks finishing on stale test results); prove-budget (Review, Stage 5, only: commands other than the project's own are killed at 120 s and never run in the background); model-router (active 2.0 feature only: subagent dispatches name a model, fable needs the user's opt-in, every review runs on opus), with role-guard (the plugin's agents stay in their role) trust-anchor (changes to what verification trusts reach the user) and review-rounds (when the check of a review's fixes still fails, only the user's reply lets work go on)
